name: Kagakukan
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional city science museum (Hoshizora Science Museum): a planetarium inspection notice, a first day helping at the reception desk, a workshop guide, an annual passport notice, an entry-flow guide, a reflection on learning from a visitor interaction, a report on teaching a new staff member how to handle the reception desk, an essay on why night openings grew popular, a typhoon/heavy-rain contingency guide, a column on the diversifying exhibits, a notice of revised workshop reservation rules, a reflection on what stays at a museum, and a one-year cooperation report on a partnership with local elementary schools. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
